name: snowlog
description: SnowLog web and Capacitor iOS application

scripts.build:web: mkdir -p dist/icons dist/sounds && cp index.html manifest.webmanifest sw.js dist/ && cp icons/* dist/icons/ && cp sounds/* dist/sounds/
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run cap:sync && cap open ios
